title: Red Hat security advisory (AV26-1163)
description: As of November 13, 2026, Red Hat is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6 / 7 / 10
	All versions

Red Hat Hardened Images
	All versions

Red Hat OpenShift Dev Spaces
	All versions

Red Hat Satellite 6.16 for RHEL 8 / 9
	Multiple versions

Red Hat Satellite 6.17 for RHEL 9
	Multiple versions

Red Hat Satellite 6.18 for RHEL 9
	Multiple versions

Red Hat Satellite 6.19 for RHEL 9
	Multiple versions

Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4
	All versions

Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 5
	All versions

mirror registry for Red Hat OpenShift 2
	All versions
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
